product_metadata.title: Firefly 5-Ounce Refillable Glass Liquid Candle - Votive Size Emergency Candles - Replacement for Liquid Paraffin Disposable Fuel Cells
features: PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS: The Firefly 5-Ounce Liquid Candle is hand blown and made from borosilicate glass; an elegant yet non-fragile glass. It stands about 3-3/4 inches tall to the tip of the wick and is about 2 inches in diameter. The wick holder rests on top of the glass and DOES NOT screw in. Because our glass candles are hand-blown, dimensions may vary by 1/16”. If placing in a votive, please measure your votive to make sure it will fit. FUEL IS NOT INCLUDED.

REFILL & REUSE: Our liquid candles are refillable which is the latest eco-friendly trend restaurants, event planners and the hospitality industry are using as a direct replacement of disposable liquid paraffin candles, aka, liquid fuel cells. You know those nasty plastic candles that hide in candle holders and end up in our landfills! We Suggest Using Firefly Safe and Green Lamp Oil.

EMERGENCY CANDLES: Homeowners are using refillable candles as emergency candles - an essential part of their preparedness kit. Bulk purchasing is a great idea because you can use the liquid candles all over your home every day, not just for those special 3-day outages! The votives will fit nicely in most candle holders and lanterns but always measure to make sure.

ECONOMICAL FIRELIGHT: From an economy perspective, fill the votives with Firefly Liquid Paraffin Lamp Oil. You can use a burn time of about 6 hours per ounce of Firefly Paraffin Lamp Oil. Results May Vary. The wick is ADJUSTABLE unlike the disposable emergency candles. This is a great feature which allows you to control the fuel usage and flame height.. So, let's do the math, a 32-ounce bottle of paraffin lamp oil will burn for approximately 192 hours - 6 hours * 32 ounces. Sweet!

IMPORTANT NOTE: Please review all of the photos. The small funnel that is included with the candle measures 1-1/2” wide and 1-5/8” tall. It has a tab to grasp. To fill, simply hold the tab, insert the funnel into the opening slightly elevated from the neck. (Do Not let it rest on the neck or the fuel will overflow.) description: Our hand-blown, borosilicate glass Votive Oil Candles are an eco-friendly, clean-burning alternative to messy wax candles and nasty disposable liquid paraffin candles also known as fuel cells. The 5-Ounce Votive: Stands about 3-5/8 inches tall to the tip of the wick and is about 2 inches in diameter. The 5-ounce votive oil candle is the tallest of the 3 refillable votives. Our candles are convenient, green, economical, well made, clean, and direct replacements for disposable fuel cells. The votive oil candles are frequently used inside of a candle holder. Many folks use them as emergency candles because they are refillable. A 32-ounce bottle of Firefly lamp oil will last well over 100 hours! Actually, you will get about 6 hours of burn time per ounce depending on the height of the adjustable wick; therefore, a 32-ounces bottle will provide approximately 192 hours of burn time. Results may vary. IMPORTANT TIP: If you are storing the fuel outside, we recommend you purchase Firefly CLEAN Lamp Oil as it will not solidify or freeze like paraffin lamp oil. They are made from a sturdy glass that is permanent, are simple to refill, and will save you money. On top of all that, they are eco-friendly as well. The candle uses a Firefly 2.6mm cotton wick (included). Replacements are available on Amazon. We suggest using unscented Firefly CLEAN Lamp Oil, Paraffin Lamp Oil or Safe & Green for the best performance. NEVER use any type of vegetable oil. Always use in a ventilated area and make sure the flame is not close to any solid material. You can easily create colored lamp oil by using Firefly lamp oil dye.
